description:
Pull real rosters from a Sleeper league and price every team with current market values: total roster value, league power ranking, and each team's best assets.

USE WHEN: the user mentions their Sleeper league or asks about their own team — 'is my team contending', 'who should I trade', 'what is my roster worth'.
Call with `sleeper_username` alone to list the user's leagues, then again with the chosen `league_id`. Read-only: nothing is written to Sleeper and no login is needed.

format.description: Value set to use. Default 'dynasty'. IMPORTANT: there is exactly ONE dynasty table and its QB values are superflex/market-weighted — dynasty values are not split by 1QB vs superflex or by scoring. The redraft sets ARE split: redraft-{sf,1qb}-{ppr,half,std}.

league_id.description: Sleeper league ID. Returns every team in the league, valued and ranked.

season.description: Season year, e.g. '2026'. Defaults to the current season.

sleeper_username.description: Sleeper username. Use this when the user has not given a league ID.

team.description: Focus on one team by manager display name or team name; full roster is listed.

name: tradegauge_get_league_roster
title: Value a Sleeper league
